2021[https://twitter.com/FNC_Upset/status/1388552597355778053/photo/1 Upset, EUW sQ rank 1]. * Married Chilean streamer [[Paulaeal]], the former owner of [[Humanoids5]], on August 3, 2021 [https://twitter.com/FNC_Upset/status/1422580071840296962 Upset's tweet] ''twitter.com''. * Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on March 6, 2022. ** The 10th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], and [[Odoamne]]. * Reached 1500 kills in the LEC on January 26, 2025. ** The 6th player to reach 1500 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Caps]], [[Perkz]], and [[Hans Sama]]. * Dealt 1,804 DMG/M playing {{ci|Zeri}} in their week 8 win against [[Team Vitality]] during [[LEC/2022 Season/Summer Season|LEC Summer 2022]], breaking the seven year old record of [[Pepiinero]]. === Individual Awards === * 1x LEC Season MVP (Spring 2025) * 3x LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Summer 2018, Spring
